newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY.

text.p: (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-83/96 Dega - environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 3, paragraph 1 and 6 of Council directive 79/112/EEC of December 18, 1978, on the approximation of member states' laws on the labelling and presentation of foodstuffs to the end consumer and on the advertising concerning them. Scope of the expression "established within the Community". Application to the producer, confectioner and seller. Pineapple slices in syrup. - (1615/1415 GMT) Oral procedure C-338/95 Wiener - free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of position 60.04 B IV b 2 bb of Common Customs and Excise Tariff applicable in 1985. Night shirts.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-336/95 Burdalo Trevejo: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 1 and 3, paragraph 3 of Council directive 77/187/EEC of February 14, 1977, on the maintenance of workers' rights in the event of transfers of undertakings, businesses or parts of businesses. Reduction by legal or jurisprudential means of amount guaranteed by virtue of Council directive 80/987/EEC of October 20, 1980, on the approximation of member state legislation on protection of salaried workers in cases of employer bankruptcy.

FOURTH CH-AMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-274/95, C-275/95, C-276/95 Ludwig Wuensche: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of sub-positions 1108 13 00 NC and 3505 10 50 NC. Esterified potato flour with an acetyl level above 0.5 percent of weight.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-127/95 Norbrook Laboratories: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directives 81/851/EEC of September 28, 1981, on the approximation of member states' legislation on veterinary drugs and of 81/852/EEC of September 28, 1981, on the approximation of member states' laws relating to analytical, pharmaco-toxicological and clinical standards and protocols in respect of the testing of veterinary medicinal products. Request to market a veterinary medicinal product. Competence of national authorities. - Oral procedure joined cases C-31/96, C-32/96, C-33/96 Naranjo Arjona: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 47, paragraph 1(e) and (g) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 1248/92 of April 30, 1992. Calculation of the theoretical amount of old age pension by the institution of a member state whose law provides payments on the basis of mean contributions. - (1000/0800 GMT) Oral procedure C-27/96 Danisco Sugar: membership. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 137, paragraph 2, 145, paragraph 2 and 149, paragraph 1 of the 1994 Membership act, of articles 39 and 40 of the EC treaty, of Council regulation 17B5/81 of June 30, 1981, on the common organisation of markets in the sugar sector and of Commission regulation 3300/94 of December 21, 1994, stopping transitional measures in the sugar sector following the adhesion of Austria, Finland and Sweden. National contribution for sugar storage introduced following the membership of Sweden and affecting the quantity of sugar stocked in Sweden at the time.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-15/95 EARL de Kerlast: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation and validity of articles 7 and 12(c) of Council regulation 857/84 of March 31, 1984, laying down general measures for the application of the levy referred to in article 5 C of regulation 804/68 in the milk and milk products sector. Interpretation of article 40, paragraph 3 of the EC treaty. Legality of the exploitation of bench mark lot sizes by a participating company. - Judgment C-90/95 P de Compte v/ Parliament: statute of officials. Appeal against Court judgment (first chamber) rendered January 26, 1995, in joined cases T-90/91 and T-62/92, Compte v/ Commission. Annulment of the EP decision of April 18, 1991, withdrawing the decision recognising the existence of a professional disease and annulling the EP decision of January 20, 1992, refusing to recognise the existence of a professional disease. - Judgment C-147/95 Evrenopoulos: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 119, protocol no. 2 annexed to the Maastricht treaty and Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters. Insurance arrangements concerning staff of a public electricity company. Survivors' pensions. Conditions for granting survivors' pensions to male survivors. Measures in law. - Judgment C-351/95 Kadiman: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 7 of EU/Turkey Association Council decision 1/80. Conditions for obtaining a prorogation of a stay permit. Determination of the regular length of stay in case of interruptions. - Opinion C-61/95 Greece v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission decision 94/871 of December 21, 1994, on the clearance of the accounts presented by Member States in respect of expenditure for 1990 of the EAGGF, Guarantee Section for the 1991 fiscal year. Milk, olive oil, cotton and tobacco sectors.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIFTH CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure joined cases T-159/94, T-160/94 Ajinomoto v/ Council: trade policy. Annulment of Council regulation 1391/91 of May 27, 1991, establishing a definitive antidumping duty on imports of aspartame from Japan and the U.S. (formerly C-223/91).

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-66/95 Sutton: social policy. - Judgment C-180/95 Draehmpaehl: social policy. - Judgment C-310/95 Road Air: external relations. - Judgment C-395/95 P Geotronics v/ Commission: external relations. - Opinion C-122/95 Germany v/ Council: external relations. - Opinion joined cases C-364/95, C-365/95 T. Port: agriculture. - Oral procedure C-391/95 Van Uden: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-149/95 Ducros v/ Commission: state aid.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, (enlarged) SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-290/94 Kayserberg v/ Commission: competition.
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-129/96 Inter-Environnement Wallonie: environment and consumers.

FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-105/96 Codiesel: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-142/96 Wacker Werke: free movement of goods. - (1000/0800 GMT) Oral procedure C-362/95 P Blackspur DIY v/ Council and Commission: trade policy.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-39/96 Free Record Shop: competition. - Opinion C-329/96 Commission v/ Greece. environment and consumers. - Opinion C-331/96 Commission v/ Greece: environment and consumers. - Oral procedure C-117/96 Mosbaek: social policy.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-145/96 van Hoffmann: taxation. - Opinion C-309/95 Commission v/ Council: state aid. - Oral procedure C-21/96 Commission v/ Spain: protection of the population. - Oral procedure C-276/96 Commission v/ Portugal: protection of the population.
